rows.en:
My name is Akemi Iwashita.
I'm a third-year.
Well then, shall I tell you a story I know?
It's {a}, isn't it?{p}Do you have a sweetheart?
I do
I don't
Scream, "Stop it already!"

...I see.
You don't.
In high school, and you don't have even one girlfriend? How lonely.{p}Do you dislike older women?
I like them
I dislike them
I prefer someone my own age
Scream, "Stop it already!"

Heh... I see.
So you like older women.{p}
...Tell me, are you the type who believes in love at first sight?
I believe in it
I don't believe in it
Scream, "Stop it already!"

Don't think I'm joking.
I want you to answer me seriously.
Well?{p}Will you make me your sweetheart?
I will
I won't
I can't answer right now
Scream, "Stop it already!"
Heh heh... What a lovely thing to say to me.{p}

There was a girl in my class named Setsuko Yaguchi.
She had a boyfriend named Mamoru Date.
The two of them were very close.
But both their families were strict, so they hardly ever got to see each other.{p}What would you do in a situation like that, {a}?
Call on the phone
Write letters
Meet in secret
Scream, "Stop it already!"

That's the quickest way.
And these days, everyone does it.
But don't you find phones frightening?
You can't see the other person's face, and you never know who might be listening.
Suddenly, the phone rings.
And what if you heard laughter you'd never heard before, or ragged breathing, coming from it...?
And you were all alone, too.
Then a low voice comes from the other end of the line.
"...I'll kill you."
Have you ever gotten a call like that?
I have, many times.
Prank calls, of course.{p}

When that happens, I curse them.
You just spit a curse at them and hang up.
The persistent ones will keep calling again and again, I suppose.
And every time,
"Die... die..."
I will it at them with all my heart.
They're the ones in the wrong.
My heart doesn't ache one bit.{p}

Phones are convenient, but they can be inconvenient in many ways too.
Anyway, the two with the strict families kept in touch by phone.{p}

Nine o'clock every night.
That was their promised time.
They took turns calling each other, one day after the other.
At nine, they'd sneak the phone into their rooms and talk in hushed voices.
Sometimes they talked all night long.
Even when their parents scolded them for the long calls, this was the one thing they couldn't give up.
And it went on without a break.
Even on days off from school, even when one of them was away on a family trip.
Without missing a single day, the two of them reaffirmed their love.{p}

In our class, too, everyone knew how close they were.
They say the couples who fight are the closest, but those two must have been the exception.
No one had ever seen them fight.
Then, one day...{p}

The pay phone beside the school's back gate.
You know it, don't you?
That's where he called from.
But, you see, anyone who knows about that phone won't use it.
Why, you ask?
Because that phone is the devil's phone.
...Funny?
You're not making fun of me, are you?
...Well, I don't mind.
You're my sweetheart now, after all.{p}

And so he used that devil's phone.
He didn't know a thing about it.{p}

"...Hello, it's me."
"Oh, Date.
Huh?
You're not calling from home today?"
"I told you I'd be late at school.
And now it's gotten this late.
I'm calling from school right now."{p}

"I see.
Be careful going home."
"Yeah, thanks.
Sorry I can't talk much today."
"...No, it's fine.
See you at school tomorrow."
"Yeah. Later."{p}

It was a much shorter call than usual.
They'd see each other at school tomorrow, and tomorrow night they'd talk to their hearts' content, making up for today.
Thinking of it that way, it wasn't lonely or painful at all.
It was the very next day.{p}

Nine o'clock at night, as always.
The phone rang.
Though she thought it was strange, Yaguchi picked up the receiver by reflex.{p}

"...Hello?"
"Oh, Yaguchi. It's me."
"Oh, Date.
What's up?"
"What do you mean, what's up?
It's our usual time, isn't it?"
"No, that's not what I mean.
Yesterday, it was you who called, right?
So today it was my turn to call."
"Oh, is that all?
...I just couldn't wait.
Because of what happened yesterday, you know?
I wanted to hear your voice as soon as I could."
"...Oh, come on, Date, you're making me blush.
Hey, you know what..."
The two of them talked.
On and on, forgetting the passage of time.{p}

It was a more satisfying call than ever.
Feeling content, Yaguchi fell asleep.{p}

The next morning, Yaguchi spotted Date at school and waved.
"Daaaaaate!"
But Date acted cold toward her.
Usually he'd wave back and give her a big smile.
He seemed somehow distant.
As if he wasn't the usual Date at all...
Worried she'd done something wrong, Yaguchi ran over to him.{p}

"...What's wrong, Date?
Are you angry about something?"
Date lowered his eyes and answered curtly.
"Why didn't you call me last night?"
"Huh?"
Yaguchi didn't understand what he meant.
Why, they'd talked on the phone for so long last night.
That had definitely been Date.
They talked on the phone every day, after all.
There was no way she'd mistake his voice.{p}

"I called you over and over last night.
But the line was busy the whole time.
Just who were you talking to?"
He was sulking.
He was only jealous, that's all.
But his words were more than enough to shock Yaguchi.
"...No way.
I was talking with you all night yesterday.
You called me, and..."
"Don't give me a lie that's so easy to see through!
Forget it!"{p}

Brushing her off completely, he stormed away somewhere with the boys he hung out with.
Everyone was surprised.
After all, it was the first time those two had ever fought.
That day, for the first time, everyone saw the two of them going their separate ways.{p}

That night, Yaguchi was crying alone in her room.
Little by little, the usual time drew closer.
The usual time she spent sweet moments with Date...
She agonized over it.
Should she call him, or should she not?{p}What do you think she did?
She called him
She waited for his call
Scream, "Stop it already!"

...But she decided to apologize first.
Because she didn't want the fight to go on like this.
And the moment it turned nine, she reached for the receiver.
That was when it happened.
The phone rang.
Without thinking, she picked up the receiver.{p}

And without even checking who it was, she said in a rush,
"I'm sorry.
It's because I didn't explain properly..."
"No, I'm the one who was wrong.
I'm sorry I yelled at you like that.
I've been thinking about what I did."
But his meek apology made Yaguchi uneasy instead.
And she asked,
"...Hey, are you Date?"
Laughter came from the receiver.
"Ah ha ha... What are you talking about?
Did you forget what my voice sounds like?"{p}

That laugh was definitely his voice.
His voice, the same as always.
Yaguchi was relieved.
And that night, too, they talked until the middle of the night.
Once you've felt uneasy, the bond grows deeper after you overcome it.
You'd do well to remember that, {a}.
Heh heh heh...
But the next day...{p}

When she ran into Date on the way to school, he was even colder than the day before.
Or rather, he was rough.
When Yaguchi's eyes met Date's, this time he came over to her himself.
But his face was sullen, and he looked furious.
And the moment he got close, he started yelling at her.
"If you're sick of me, just say so!
You've got a new boyfriend, haven't you!"
Yaguchi was taken aback once again.
And not knowing how to respond to his harsh words, she finally burst into tears.{p}

Date had never imagined Yaguchi would cry, so he panicked.
Then he regained his composure and began to apologize.
At last, the two of them could talk calmly.
And they found out.
Something was passing itself off as Date.{p}

"What a creep.
I'm going to find him no matter what and beat him to a pulp!"
Date was by no means the kind of person who resorted to violence recklessly.
But he couldn't forgive the man who had tormented his beloved Yaguchi.{p}

"Listen, I'll call you tonight.
So don't call me, no matter what.
That way, I'll be sure to get you, right?"
Even after hearing Yaguchi out, Date still looked uneasy.
There was no telling what tricks the man using his name might pull.
And Yaguchi might be fooled again.
So he decided to make doubly sure.
"I know.
Let's think of some way so that guy can't get in our way this time.
It looks like he's jealous of what we've got."
Yaguchi agreed with Date's suggestion.{p}
...Say, {a}.{p}What would you do?
Change the time of the call
Hang up as soon as it rings once, then call back again
Have a parent answer the phone first
Scream, "Stop it already!"

That's the best way.
I use that trick often myself.
{a}, let's decide on a code of our own too.
Heh heh...
And that's what they did.{p}

"Okay then, I'll let the phone ring three times and hang up.
Then I'll call again right after.
If by any chance you have to call me, do the same, okay?"
"Okay, got it.
Then tonight I'll sit right by the phone and wait.
Make sure you call me."
"Yes, of course."
"This has to stay a secret between the two of us.
Don't tell anyone, okay?"
"Okay."
And the two of them hooked pinkies on it.{p}

That night, Yaguchi sat on her bed hugging her knees, waiting for nine o'clock.
She set the phone at her feet and waited, her heart pounding.{p}
And the moment it turned nine, she made the call.{p}

"...Huh, it's busy."
The line was busy.
She'd been so keyed up that it felt like a taut string had snapped.
So she put down the receiver, and a little later she called again.{p}
It was still busy.{p}

Yesterday and the day before, she'd gotten calls from the man pretending to be Date.
Both times, Date said he'd called many times, but her line was busy the whole time.
Now it was the exact opposite.
What if the same thing was happening at his house...
Yaguchi suddenly felt afraid.
What if there was a woman using her name, and she was calling Date right now?{p}

Yaguchi dialed frantically, over and over.
She meant to keep calling until she finally heard it ring.
...Even so, all she heard from the other end was that monotonous tone.
When she glanced at the clock, it was already past ten.
And then!{p}

The phone rang.
It rang exactly three times, then stopped.
"It's Date!"
Yaguchi was so happy she said it out loud.
Time crawled by terribly slowly until the next ring.
As if time itself had stopped.{p}

Yaguchi picked up the receiver without hesitating.
And she cried out.{p}

"Date!"
A heavy, sullen male voice came from the receiver.{p}

"...Why the hell are you still at home?!
You're the one who told me to come right away, Yaguchi!"
"Huh?"
The person on the line was definitely Date.
But once again, what he was saying made no sense to Yaguchi.
"You called a minute ago saying you just had to see me, so I managed to sneak out.
So why are you at home?!"{p}

...Just as she'd feared, a woman using Yaguchi's name had been calling his house.
Who on earth... and why...?
"...So what's it gonna be?
Are you coming?
Or not?"
As she was lost in those thoughts, she heard his irritated voice.{p}...Tell me, what do you think she answered?
She'd go
She wouldn't go
Scream, "Stop it already!"

"I-I'll come."
She answered on the spot.
"Then get over here, now."
"Wait a second!
Where should I go?"
"...You're the one who called me out here, what are you talking about?
In front of the pay phone by the school's back gate.
I'm calling you from it right now.
Hurry up and get here!"
With that, he hung up roughly.{p}

...Was that call really from him?
Maybe someone had pretended to be Date and called again...
But only the two of them were supposed to know their promise to ring three times and hang up.
She felt an unease she couldn't put into words.{p}And what do you think she did?
She went to the school
She didn't go to the school
She tried calling his house
Scream, "Stop it already!"

That's right.
So, to make sure, she tried calling Date's house.{p}

This time, the call went through.
After a few rings, a woman answered.{p}

"...Hello."
"Um, is this the Date residence?
I'm sorry to call so late at night, but is Mamoru there, please?"
"...Mamoru went out a little while ago.
Something about having to go pick up a notebook he'd lent a friend."
"Oh, I see.
I'm very sorry to have bothered you."{p}

The one who'd answered was his mother.
But that made her feel a little relieved.
At least Date wasn't at home.
Going to get a notebook had to be an excuse.
He must be waiting at the school's back gate right now.
When she thought of that, she couldn't help but hurry.{p}

"I guess he went home after all...
There's nobody at the pay phone."
The area was eerily silent.
Well, it was a school in the middle of the night, after all.
No one was passing by, and there was no sign of anyone hiding.
He must have gone home.
Just as Yaguchi gave up and was about to head home...{p}

Suddenly, a phone rang.
It was the pay phone, which had no reason to ring at all.{p}

Who could be calling?
Somehow, it seemed the bell was ringing just for her.
What should she do?{p}At a time like this, would you pick up the receiver?
Pick it up
Don't pick it up
Wait and see a little longer
Scream, "Stop it already!"

She reached out her hand, as if lured.
And she grabbed the receiver.
Slowly, she lifted it.
With a click, the ringing stopped.{p}
Then, fearfully, she brought the receiver to her ear.{p}

"........."
Without a word, she focused all her attention on her ear.
Nothing at all came from the other end of the line.
Whoever it was seemed to be waiting for her to respond, too, quietly watching to see what she'd do.
What should she do?{p}Would you try saying something?
Say something
Keep waiting like this
Hang up the phone
Scream, "Stop it already!"

She worked up her courage and spoke.
Maybe because unease had wrapped itself around her whole body, her voice came out terribly shrill.{p}

"...Hello?"
Even so, the other side said nothing.
"Huh? What?"
But when she listened carefully, she could hear a very, very tiny voice.
"......ser...ear..."
She pressed the receiver against her ear, trying to make out what it was saying.
This is what the voice was saying.
"...Closer... closer... bring your ear closer..."
It sounded like a child.
Like the voice of a little girl.
She pressed the receiver tight against her ear.
So hard it hurt.
That was when it happened.{p}

"Aaaaaaaaaaagh!"
Yaguchi screamed and flung the receiver away.
She clapped her hand to her ear without thinking, and it was burning hot.
And then, can you imagine, her palm was smeared with a slimy liquid.
It was blood.
Her legs gave out, and she slumped to the ground right there and couldn't move anymore.{p}

When she looked at the flung receiver, swinging back and forth like a swing, the part she'd held to her ear was stained bright red.
And from inside the receiver, a thick, cloudy white liquid was spewing out.
The cloudy white liquid mixed with the red blood, turning a pretty shade of pale pink.
When it dripped onto the ground, it hissed, and a thin wisp of smoke rose up.
Then a sharp, sour smell stung her nose.
...Acid?
It seemed like a powerful acid, the kind that dissolves things.
She couldn't understand why something like that would come out of a phone receiver.{p}

The hand pressing her bloody ear was already sticky all over.
She couldn't feel her ear at all.
So much that she couldn't even tell whether her ear was still there, or had already melted away.
She tried to run.
But her legs had given out, and she couldn't stand up properly.
The moment she tried to drag her whole body away from the receiver...{p}

Suddenly, the receiver attacked her.
Just like a living thing.{p}

"Mmmmmmmmph!"
With the receiver forced into her mouth, she let out a scream that never became a voice.

She could feel the inside of her mouth bubbling as it burned raw.
When she moved her tongue in agony, the liquid clung to it and scorched it.

And the cord squeezed her neck tighter and tighter.
The more she struggled to pull it off, the more gleefully the cord dug into her neck.
Her eyes rolled back, and she flailed her arms like a puppet on strings.
...And then she died.{p}

Her death was written off as a murder by some sicko.
They say her body was too horrible to look at twice.
It was as if all the flesh around her mouth had been ripped away, and the bone was laid bare.
And the inside of her mouth was burned raw and discolored, as if it had rotted.
The phone cord was wound tightly around her neck.
...In the end, they say that during those three cursed days, Date never once spoke to her on the phone.
And neither did Date's mother.
But Date doesn't realize that he's the one who killed Yaguchi.
I mean, think about it.
That day he was late because of club, if Date hadn't called her house from that pay phone, she wouldn't have had to die.
That's why she died.
The devil that lives in that phone must have taken a liking to Yaguchi's voice, don't you think?
Yaguchi had such a beautiful voice, you see.
So it played those tricks on her, and dragged her into its own world.
That's what I think.{p}

...Are you laughing?
You don't believe my story, do you?
Because I tell it as if I'd seen it with my own eyes.
But I know.{p}

How do I know, you ask?
I heard it from her herself.
You see, she calls me.
Yaguchi, that is.
Sometimes, my phone gets crossed lines.
And then I end up hearing things like the voices of the dead.
It seems Yaguchi still loves the phone, even after death.
Even though a phone killed her.
But she says she doesn't hold a grudge against Date.
She must have loved him very much.
But you know, she said that if Date betrays her, she'll kill him.
Laughing, having fun, on the other end of the line.
She said if he ever falls for another girl, she won't hesitate to take him over to her world.{p}

Women, you know... are frightening when you make them angry.
Say, {a}.
You said you'd be my boyfriend, didn't you?
I fell for you at first sight, you know.
I'll call you tonight.{p}

I'll call you every single day.
Don't worry, I don't need to ask for your phone number. I can find it out easily enough.
Wait for my call.
Shall we set a time for our calls?
What time would be good?
Nine?
Or ten?
Don't you ever betray me.
If you do, I won't hesitate to kill you.
I'm very possessive, you see.{p}

Heh heh heh heh...
This gathering will be over soon, won't it?
Once we've heard the sixth story, let's go home together.
Of course, you'll walk me all the way home.
It's gotten very late, after all.
Heh heh heh heh...{p}

...I see. So you have one.
Tell me, what is she like?
Is she more beautiful than me?
Don't think it's a strange thing to ask.
It matters to me.{p}Who is more beautiful, your sweetheart or me?
My sweetheart
Akemi Iwashita
I can't say either way
Scream, "Stop it already!"

...I see.
If she's that beautiful, won't you introduce me to her sometime?
She's {a}'s sweetheart, of all people. I'd love to see her.
Say, that's all right, isn't it?
It's a promise.{p}

...Still, I'm envious.
Calling your sweetheart 'beautiful' so openly is something you can only do if you truly love her.
You really treasure her, don't you, {a}?
But you had better be careful.
When two people are too close, there will always be those who resent it.
The story I'm about to tell is about lovers like that.
But there is one important rule for telling this story.
The one who tells it must be with their lover.
Otherwise, they'll be cursed by the lovers in the story.
But I don't have a lover.
So, {a}, won't you play my lover, just for now?
You'll do it, won't you?
Yes, you'll do it, {a}. I'm sure of it.
I know you will.
Otherwise, I can't tell this story.
Say, that's all right, isn't it?
......There, you nodded.
You really are kind, {a}.
If I were to take a real lover, someone like you might be nice.
Oh, I know.
This is only an act... but just for now, we're lovers.
All right, {a}?{p}

Why, thank you.
I'm happy, even if it's only flattery.
......Of course it's flattery, isn't it?
You're not the kind of person who makes passes at other girls when he already has a sweetheart, are you?
That would be rude to your sweetheart.
And to me, too.
Surely you didn't take me for some cheap girl who gets ideas the moment someone flatters her?
I loathe people who make a fool of me.
So if that's what you had in mind, I'll come to hate you.
It's frightening to make an enemy of me, you know.
...Heh heh, look at that face.
I can tell from your eyes that you're not that kind of person, {a}.
I'm joking. Only joking.
But since you answered like that, does it mean you're rather fond of me?
If that's so...
Won't you break up with your sweetheart and go out with me instead?{p}

...'I can't say either way,' you say?
What a strange thing to say.
Aren't you going out with your sweetheart because you love them?
When you love someone, they seem beautiful to you, don't they?
Or are you just going out with someone you don't even like all that much, for no particular reason?
Or else...........{p}

Now I understand. Heh heh.
You don't have a sweetheart at all, do you?
You were too embarrassed to admit you're in high school and still don't have one, so you couldn't tell the truth.
I understand how you feel.{p}

But lying is no good.
I hate lies.
And more than that, there's a reason you mustn't tell this kind of lie.
Today, I'll tell you that story.{p}

...He was a student at this school.
His name was... let's see, why don't we call him Higashiyama.
He didn't have a girlfriend either.
Not that he was the type girls ignored.
He was no pop idol, but his looks were decent enough.
...That's exactly why he pretended to have a girlfriend.
It was too uncool to admit he didn't have one.
Every time his friends asked, he'd talk about a girlfriend he'd made up on the spot.
A cute type, with big round eyes, who looked good with short hair, he'd say.{p}
Then one day.

As Higashiyama went on about his imaginary girlfriend yet again, one of his friends said,
"Show me a picture of her,"
just like that.
There was no way he could do that, of course.
Just as Higashiyama was about to refuse, his student handbook fell out of his pocket.{p}

And so did a photo that had been tucked inside the handbook.
It was a photo of a cute girl who wasn't a student at this school.
His friend took it for granted she was Higashiyama's girlfriend.
But Higashiyama had no idea about it.
Not whose photo it was, or even when it had gotten into his pocket.
And the strange things didn't stop there.{p}

That day after school, a girl was standing in front of the main gate.
Higashiyama was startled.
Because it was the girl in the photo.
When he rushed over, she gave him a big smile, can you imagine.
"You're late. Today's your treat, Higashiyama."
And with that, she took his arm.
Higashiyama was startled.
But he didn't mind it.
She was a cute girl, and he probably thought she'd fallen for him at first sight and was putting on an act.
So he went along with her without a fuss.{p}Where do you think she went?
Higashiyama's house
A nearby park
Scream, "Stop it already!"

She headed for Higashiyama's house as if it were only natural.
Just like a real couple.
Strangely enough, Higashiyama gradually stopped finding her presence strange.
He even felt as if he'd known her for a long time.
Well, of course he did.
She looked exactly like the imaginary girlfriend Higashiyama had made up.{p}

When they got to Higashiyama's room, she promptly sat right down.
And so naturally, too, as if that was where she always sat.
Higashiyama had let his guard down completely.
I imagine he felt as if his girlfriend had just come over to visit.
Even so, a tiny bit of sanity still remained.
So he asked her.
"Who are you?"
Then the girl looked sad.
"Why would you ask me that?
I came here to be your girlfriend..."
And with that, she burst into tears.
Higashiyama hurried to her side.
And to comfort her, he put his hand on her shoulder...{p}
At that moment, he felt as if every hair on his body stood on end.

Her body was as cold as ice.
As he hurriedly tried to pull his arm back, her cold hand seized it.
Her face was right next to Higashiyama's.
But by now, she was nothing like a cute girl.
She looked like something else entirely, wearing a human skin.
"Surprised that I'm cold...?
Well, there was nothing in your mind about how warm a girl's body is..."{p}

Her face warped and twisted.
And her voice got squashed along with it.
You know helium gas, right?
When you breathe it in, your voice goes all strange.
...They say it was like that.
In that voice, she kept on talking.
"If you'd just believed I was your girlfriend, you could have died happy.
I'd have liked that better too... because a soul at the height of happiness tastes so delicious."
She licked her lips.
And that was when Higashiyama realized.
She wasn't his girlfriend... she wasn't even human.
But by then it was too late.
Her frozen lips caught the nape of Higashiyama's neck.
And at that same moment, all the strength to resist drained from his body.{p}
